headline: Jogorku Kenesh adopted the republican budget for 2027 and amendments to the 2026 budget
summary: The Jogorku Kenesh adopted in first reading the draft republican budget for 2027, along with budgets for the Social Fund and the Compulsory Medical Insurance Fund, and amendments to the 2026 budget. The bills still require further readings.
why: The national budget sets government spending and revenue targets, which influence fiscal deficits, borrowing needs and the outlook for public investment in Kyrgyzstan.
original_headline: ЖК принял республиканский бюджет на 2027 год и поправки в бюджет 2026-го
